verdict.rationale: Relay documents banking (checking accounts, cards, wires/ACH), bill pay (upload bills, approvals, vendor payments), spend management (cards, limits, roles), invoicing/receivables, and accounting sync (QuickBooks/Xero) all in one platform, corroborated by community reviews confirming multi-account partitioning and usability. Missing for 10: independent case studies of founders actually consolidating from multiple prior tools, and community feedback notes manual execution still needed for external payments and some permission glitches.
